title: High Pressure Switch Open
fullDescription: York Affinity AC reports E1 when the high-pressure safety switch trips.

title: Low Pressure Switch Open
fullDescription: E2 fires when refrigerant pressure on the low side drops below the switch threshold.

title: Indoor Coil Freeze
fullDescription: E3 trips when indoor coil temp drops near freezing.

title: Outdoor Fan Locked Rotor
fullDescription: E4 is set when the outdoor fan motor draws stall current.

title: Compressor Thermal Trip
fullDescription: E5 indicates the internal compressor overload has cut the compressor's circuit due to motor over-temperature.

title: Compressor Lockout
fullDescription: E6 is the lockout state after multiple compressor safeties trip.

title: Indoor Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F1 indicates the indoor coil thermistor is open or shorted.

title: Outdoor Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F2 fires when the outdoor air thermistor reading is out of range.

title: Power Quality Issue
fullDescription: P0 trips on voltage out of range — typically below 195V or above 253V on 230V systems.

title: Comm Loss
fullDescription: U1 indicates the comm bus between indoor and outdoor failed.
